I spoke with Javier to try to understand why the water and chocolate temperatures were rising during third shift. He mentioned that lowering the temperature setpoints too much could affect the tempering process. The OPL posted next to the screen indicates that they should be maintained between 25°C and 25.5°C, but the pictures from third shift show setpoints of 24.5°C and 24.6°C. We’re not sure why they were set that low, and Javier is not sure if this contributed to the issue.

I restored the pump settings to the correct values, and the system is now running properly.
